Hmm gotcha. Then `toHaveBeenCalledWith` could replace `toHaveBeenLastCalledWith` since we've already asserted a single call was made.

I find `toHaveBeenLastCalledWith` to be what you need most of the time, it's a good default. It makes sure that if the assertion is used elsewhere, it's still relevant. Otherwise you can get false positives because a previous call received the passed arguments. You want to check the last call most times you use it, so it's fine as a default.

I agree that the APIs overlap slightly now, because the output of `getLocation` is used in `createURL`. I'm not sure if it's a big deal though since we'll rework these APIs soon. It's an enabler for SSR.

Ultimately, we shouldn't need `getLocation` and we shouldn't pass `location` in `createURL` and `parseURL`, this is why we need to provide this SSR-safe layer.
